name: Pace University — BFA in Commercial Dance (Sands College)
institution: Pace University · Sands College of Performing Arts

fit.note: Commercial Dance BFA — ballet/jazz/hip hop/tap/theater dance. Strong commercial fit.

sources.label: Sands College of Performing Arts admissions overview
Pace undergraduate key dates and deadlines

rounds.label: Early Decision

academicDeadline.note: Key Dates page, 'Fall 2027 Admission (September Start)' section: 'November 1: Early Decision (Binding) Application Deadline.' Binding only if audition/interview completed by Dec 1 per pace.edu/sands/admissions.

artsSupplementDeadline.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section: 'January 3: Final Date to submit a pre-screen for Sands College of Performing Arts.'

decisionRelease.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section: 'December 1: Early Decision decision Notification.' pace.edu/sands/admissions confirms combined academic+artistic decision for ED applicants issued in December.

rounds.notes: Submit the Pace admissions application BEFORE beginning the artistic review.

academicDeadline.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section: 'December 1: Sands College of Performing Arts Application Deadline.'

artsSupplementDeadline.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section: 'January 3: Final Date to submit a pre-screen for Sands College of Performing Arts.'

decisionRelease.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section: 'March 31: Sands College of Performing Arts Decision Notification.'

portal.note: VERIFIED source: applicants create one Acceptd profile and upload pre-screens for all Sands programs. Reconfirmed via pace.edu/sands/admissions ('Create profile on Acceptd and submit pre-screen materials').

fee.note: pace.edu/sands/admissions: 'A $90.00 non-refundable audition fee will be collected at the time of your Acceptd upload.' Page states no specific cycle year for the fee amount.

deadline.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section: 'January 3: Final Date to submit a pre-screen for Sands College of Performing Arts.'

prescreenRequired.note: Not gated in the usual sense: after the pre-screen, dancers must attend a scheduled audition (pick date on Acceptd). Reconfirmed via pace.edu/sands/admissions 5-step process (Academic Application -> Audition/Portfolio Upload -> Callback Decision -> Live Audition/Interview -> Decision Letter).

value.text: One solo dance video under 2 minutes (self-, teacher-, or friend-choreographed; studio or featured footage allowed).
Recording of the ballet instructional combination provided on Acceptd.
Recording of the jazz instructional combination provided on Acceptd.
Optional 'wild card' video — anything the applicant chooses.

videoSpec.note: Reconfirmed via pace.edu/sands/admissions: 'Commercial Dance BFA: Two arabesque photos, solo dance video under two minutes, ballet and jazz instructional video recordings, optional wild card.' Added the arabesque-photo requirement, not previously captured. No cycle year stated on page.

auditions.label: In-person audition — NYC

date.note: No calendar of specific audition dates is published. pace.edu/sands/admissions: after prescreen callback, 'selected candidates receive audition/interview dates'; applicants pick date preferences on Acceptd. Reconfirmed absence of specific dates as of 2026-08-11.

registrationOpens.note: Not published — audition scheduling happens via Acceptd after prescreen callback, no fixed registration-open date found (checked 2026-08-11).

registrationDeadline.note: No separate registration deadline found distinct from the Jan 3 pre-screen deadline (checked 2026-08-11).

auditions.notes: Required after pre-screen. Clusters with other NYC-school auditions.

auditions.label: Virtual audition (limited)

date.note: No virtual-audition-specific info found on pace.edu/sands/admissions, the Key Dates page, or the Sands audition requirements page as of 2026-08-11. Recommend a direct phone/email follow-up with performingarts@pace.edu to confirm virtual-audition availability for a Puerto Rico-based applicant.

auditions.notes: Relevant for a San Juan applicant — confirm availability.

testPolicy.note: Dedicated Test-Optional Policy page confirms: SAT/ACT not required for most applicants; all admitted students (except international first-years) considered for merit scholarships without test scores. Page does not tie the policy to a specific Fall 2027 / 2026-27 cycle statement.

recommendations.note: Not stated on the Sands audition requirements page, Commercial Dance program page, pace.edu/sands/admissions, or the Sands admissions FAQ (checked 2026-08-11). Unconfirmed whether letters of recommendation are required.

essays.note: No supplemental-essay requirement found on the Sands-specific pages checked (auditions-sands, sands/admissions, sands/admissions/faq) as of 2026-08-11.

interview.value: Interview part of the Sands audition/interview process
interview.note: Reconfirmed via pace.edu/sands/admissions: live audition/interview required for admission consideration after callback.

amount.note: pace.edu/sands/admissions confirms Pace offers 'artistic scholarships' among its financial considerations but publishes no amount or criteria (checked 2026-08-11).

deadline.note: No separate talent-scholarship deadline found; presumably tied to audition process (checked 2026-08-11).

amount.note: Commercial Dance BFA program page: 'Merit scholarships offer up to $33,000 annually.' No test scores required (all admitted students except international first-years considered automatically). Page ties figure to current catalog, not explicitly to Fall 2027.

deadline.note: No separate merit-scholarship deadline published; awarded automatically at admission review per program page (checked 2026-08-11).

requiresSeparateApp.note: Test-Optional Policy page: 'All admitted students...are considered for a merit scholarship and do not need to submit the SAT or ACT' — implies automatic consideration, no separate application.

fafsaRequired.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section, lists 'November 15: Early Decision FAFSA Priority Deadline' and 'December 1: Early Action FAFSA priority Deadline,' confirming FAFSA applies to the Fall 2027 cycle.

cssProfileRequired.note: No CSS Profile requirement mentioned on the Pace financial aid FAQ (pace.edu/financial-aid/resources/faq, checked 2026-08-11); page discusses FAFSA only. Not an explicit confirmation of FAFSA-only, so left tbd.

priorityDeadline.note: Key Dates page, Fall 2027 Admission section: 'November 15: Early Decision FAFSA Priority Deadline.' A separate Early Action FAFSA priority deadline of December 1, 2026 is listed on the same page.

tuitionAnnual.note: Commercial Dance BFA program page: full-time undergraduate tuition for 2025–2026 is $62,040. 2026–27 rate not yet published.

totalCostOfAttendance.note: Full cost of attendance (incl. room/board/fees) not published on the Commercial Dance BFA program page (checked 2026-08-11).

cohortSize.note: Sands Admissions FAQ: 'The BFA Commercial Dance incoming class is 34 per year.' No specific cycle year stated.

acceptanceRate.note: Not published on the Sands admissions FAQ or Commercial Dance BFA program page (checked 2026-08-11).

genreEmphasis.note: Program page also lists 'aerial arts' among training styles alongside ballet/jazz/hip hop/tap/theater dance — added; not tied to a specific cycle year.

companyAffiliation.note: Program page: residencies/collaborations with these companies; guest choreographers have included Andy Blankenbuehler and Mandy Moore. No specific cycle year stated.

notable.value: NYC Commercial Dance BFA integrating acting, vocal training, and choreography.
notable.note: Reconfirmed unchanged. Program page also notes: first bi-coastal BFA program requiring a Los Angeles semester junior year; Pace ranked #4 most-represented university on Broadway (2023–24) and among top 13 musical theater colleges in America (2025).
